topics.description: The FBI is investigating the death of former Indianapolis Colts owner Jim Irsay. The investigation is ongoing, and no details have been released. This story is trending due to the high profile of the individual involved and the potential for a large-scale investigation.

CMS has directed the state of Minnesota to limit provider enrollment in Medicaid. This directive is in response to concerns about Medicaid fraud. This story is trending due to the potential impact on healthcare providers and patients in Minnesota.
